summary: Verified the in-app fullscreen map control on /karte (MapCanvas.tsx). Backend suite (49 tests) and frontend typecheck pass. All 7 browser checks covering the 7 acceptance criteria passed, including one run through the public preview ingress URL. The 'card' variant criterion (used only on the auth-gated /beitrag route) could not be exercised end-to-end because no test credentials are available; it is marked blocked with an action item rather than failed.

action_items.detail: The 'card' variant of MapCanvas (fullscreen button + zoom controls) only renders on /beitrag, which requires a logged-in user (useStore().user). No working credentials are present in the briefing or /app/memory/test_credentials.md (it explicitly states no test accounts exist, real Supabase DB with email confirmation). Could not browser-verify 'Other map variant still works' end-to-end for fullscreen; code reading confirms the same toggleFullscreen/aria-pressed/data-testid wiring is reused for the card variant (MapCanvas.tsx lines 108-114), so behavior is expected to match the floating variant, but this is not independently browser-verified.

checks.criterion: Fullscreen control opens the map in an in-app fullscreen view
checks.name: map-fullscreen-opens-inapp-layer
checks.evidence: At 390x844 on /karte, map-fullscreen-button aria-pressed toggled false->true on click; map-floating gained classes fixed/inset-0/z-50; route stayed /karte (no navigation).

checks.criterion: Fullscreen map shows map content and controls
checks.name: map-fullscreen-shows-content-and-controls
checks.evidence: After opening fullscreen: map-image, map-layers-button, map-zoom-in-button, map-zoom-out-button all visible; document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth (no horizontal scroll).

checks.name: map-fullscreen-closes-cleanly
checks.evidence: Opened fullscreen (body.style.overflow became 'hidden'), then toggled again: aria-pressed became 'false', map-floating lost fixed/z-50 classes, body.style.overflow no longer 'hidden', route remained /karte.

checks.criterion: Zoom/pan and map data are not changed
checks.name: map-fullscreen-zoom-pins-unchanged
checks.evidence: Inside fullscreen, clicking map-zoom-in-button changed the --pin-scale CSS var on map-content (TransformWrapper still reacting to zoom); seeded map pins (if any) remained visible after zoom.

checks.name: map-fullscreen-mobile-safe-viewport
checks.evidence: At 390x844, map-fullscreen-button bounding box >= 44x44px, positioned within viewport bounds (x+width<=390, y>=0); no horizontal scroll; zero >=400 HTTP responses and zero non-favicon console errors during the flow.

checks.name: card-variant-fullscreen (code review only)
checks.evidence: Card variant only mounts on /beitrag, gated behind `if (!user) return <...Melde dich an.../>` (beitrag.tsx:36). No credentials available (see action_items) to log in and browser-verify. Source inspection confirms identical data-testid=map-fullscreen-button wiring/aria-pressed/toggleFullscreen reused for variant='card' (MapCanvas.tsx:108-114).

checks.name: core-routes-no-regression-390
checks.evidence: Guest flow /, /karte, /entdecken loaded at 390x844 with zero >=400 responses and zero non-favicon console errors. Also: `cd /app/frontend && yarn typecheck` -> tsc --noEmit exit 0; backend pytest suite -> 49 passed, 0 failed.

checks.name: public-preview-map-fullscreen
checks.evidence: Ran against https://leonida-karte--6tt5kohx.preview.emergentagent.com: guest->/karte, fullscreen button toggled aria-pressed true/false, map-floating gained/lost fixed class, zero >=400 responses.
